_om: Kortkongen in English (Card King, rusj.no/en/card-king/): Klondike patience, with «Today's deal». Cards: «7 of spades», «queen of hearts». Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Trekk ett kort fra bunken. Roligere – fl: Draw one card from the pile. More relaxed – more deals come out.
Trekk tre kort om gangen. Klassisk og me: Draw three cards at a time. Classic and trickier.
Bunken, {antall} igjen. Trykk for å trek: The pile, {antall} left. Tap to draw {kort}.
Bunken er tom. Trykk for å legge kortene: The pile is empty. Tap to put the cards back.
Kortene er lagt tilbake i bunken: The cards are back in the pile
Solved! The cards go home by themselves.
Kabalen er løst. Kortene går hjem av seg: The game is solved. The cards go home by themselves.
{kort} er valgt. Trykk der kortene skal: {kort} picked up. Tap where the cards should go: {hvor}. Or tap the card again.
{kort} er valgt. Trykk der kortet skal l: {kort} picked up. Tap where the card should go: {hvor}. Or tap the card again.
Trykk der kortet skal ligge – eller på k: Tap where the card should go – or tap the card again
Kabalen kan fortsatt gå opp: This game can still come out
Låst: kabalen kan ikke gå opp herfra. Vi: Stuck: the game can't come out from here. Show what you can do.
Vanskelig å si om kabalen kan gå opp her: Hard to say whether the game can come out from here
From here the game can't come out.
Herfra kan ikke kabalen gå opp. Du kan s: From here the game can't come out. You can rewind to the last position that can.
Fant ingen stilling som kan gå opp. Prøv: Couldn't find a position that can come out. Try a new deal.
Spolt tilbake {trekk}. Herfra kan kabale: Rewound {trekk}. From here the game can come out.
Herfra kan ikke kabalen gå opp. Spol til: From here the game can't come out. Rewind, and you'll get hints from there.
Ingen flere trekk. Angre, eller start en: No more moves. Undo, or start a new deal.
Legg kortene tilbake i bunken: Put the cards back in the pile
Få alle kortene hjem i fire bunker – én: Get all the cards home in four piles – one for each suit, from ace to king.
Legg kortene i synkende rekkefølge, anne: Lay the cards in descending order, alternating red and black: black 8 on red 9, red 7 on black 8.
Trykk på et kort, så flytter det seg dit: Tap a card and it moves to where it can go. If it can go in more than one place, the places light up: tap the one you want – or tap the card again for the best one. You can drag the cards too.
Essene går hjem øverst til venstre. Bygg: The aces go home at the top left. Build up in the same suit: 2, 3, 4 … all the way to the king.
Står du fast? Trykk på bunken for å trek: Stuck? Tap the pile to draw new cards. When it's empty, the cards go back.
Bare en konge kan legges på en tom plass: Only a king can go on an empty space.
Snu kortene med baksiden opp så fort du: Turn over the face-down cards as soon as you can – they often hide the key.
«Hint» viser et lurt trekk, og «Angre» t: ‘Hint’ shows a clever move, and ‘Undo’ takes back as many moves as you like.
Merket øverst sier om kabalen fortsatt k: The badge at the top tells you whether the game can still come out. If it says ‘Stuck’, you can rewind to the last position that can.
Dagens kabal er den samme for alle og ka: Today's deal is the same for everyone and can always come out. You can try it as many times as you like – a new one arrives at midnight.
Når alle kortene ligger med bildet opp,: Once every card is face up, the rest go home by themselves.
{dager} på rad med dagens kabal – i dag: {dager} in a row with today's deal – today too?
Ace to king, red on black.
Hvor mange kort trekker du?: How many cards do you draw?
Hver kabal er sjekket på forhånd: den ka: Every deal is checked in advance: it can come out – if you play cleverly.
Dagens kabal er i gang og beholder korte: Today's deal is under way and keeps its cards.
Your choice applies to today's deal too.
Første dag i en ny rekke – kom tilbake i: Day one of a new streak – come back tomorrow.
Første kabal i boks – nå har du rekorder: Your first game in the bag – now you've got records to beat!
No cards made it home this time.
The next deal could be yours.
Statistikken ligger bare på denne mobile: Your statistics are only kept on this phone.
Alle seirer, rekker og rekorder slettes: All wins, streaks and records will be deleted from this phone.
Kortene er de samme. Tid og trekk begynn: The cards stay the same. Time and moves start from zero.
Kabalen du holder på med, teller som tap: The game you're playing will count as lost in your statistics.
Den ligger klar der du slapp – helt til: It'll be waiting where you left off – until midnight.
It will count as lost in your statistics.
You can always start a new one.
Bygg hele rekker i samme sort: Build whole runs in one suit
Alle kortene synlige, fire frie celler: Every card face up, four free cells
Rydd tre topper – ett opp eller ned: Clear three peaks – one up or down
Rydd sju kolonner – ett opp eller ned: Clear seven columns – one up or down
Bunken, {antall} igjen. Trykk for å legg: The pile, {antall} left. Tap to deal one card onto every column.
{kort} er valgt. Trykk på kortet som gir: {kort} picked up. Tap the card that makes 13 with it: {hvor}. Or tap the card again.
Trykk på kortet som gir 13 sammen med de: Tap the card that makes 13 with it
Bygg hele rekker fra konge til ess i sam: Build whole runs from king to ace in one suit. A whole run goes home by itself – eight runs, and the game comes out.
Et kort kan legges på et kort som er ett: A card can go on a card one higher, in any suit: 7 on 8, 8 on 9.
Kort i samme sort og i rekkefølge kan fl: Cards in one suit and in order can move together. Tap a card and it moves – or drag it.
Står du fast, trykk på bunken: da får hv: Stuck? Tap the pile and every column gets a new card. Every column must have cards first.
Med én sort er kabalen rolig, med fire s: With one suit it's relaxed; with four suits it's properly tricky.
En tom kolonne tar hvilket som helst kor: An empty column takes any card – it's worth its weight in gold.
Snu kortene med baksiden opp så fort du: Turn over the face-down cards as soon as you can.
Få alle kortene hjem i fire bunker – én: Get all the cards home in four piles – one for each suit, from ace to king. Every card is face up from the start.
Legg kortene i synkende rekkefølge, anne: Lay the cards in descending order, alternating red and black: black 8 on red 9.
Øverst til venstre er det fire celler so: At the top left are four cells that hold one card each. Use them wisely – they fill up fast.
En rekke kan flyttes samlet når det er n: A run can move in one go when there are enough free cells and empty columns to move it card by card.
En tom kolonne tar hvilket som helst kor: An empty column takes any card.
Kort som ingen trenger lenger, går hjem: Cards nobody needs any more go home by themselves.
Nesten alle kabalene kan gå opp – og all: Almost every deal can come out – and every one here can.
Fjern alle de 52 kortene, to og to: kort: Remove all 52 cards, two at a time: the cards in a pair must add up to 13.
Ess er 1, knekt 11 og dame 12. 6 og 7, 4: Ace is 1, jack 11 and queen 12. 6 and 7, 4 and 9, queen and ace … Tap a card, then the card that makes 13 with it.
En konge er 13 alene: trykk på den, så f: A king is 13 on its own: tap it and it's gone.
Trykk på bunken for å trekke et kort. De: Tap the pile to draw a card. The card you drew and the top card of the waste pile can be used too. You only go through the pile once.
Et kort er ledig når ingen kort ligger o: A card is free when no card lies on top of it.
Kabalen går opp først når pyramiden, bun: The game only comes out when the pyramid, the pile and the waste pile are all empty.
Alle kabalene her kan gå opp – blant hel: Every deal here can come out – of completely random deals, only a few do.
Rydd alle tre toppene. Kortene går til k: Clear all three peaks. The cards go to the waste pile one at a time.
Trykk på et ledig kort som er ett høyere: Tap a free card that is one higher or one lower than the card on the waste pile. Suit and colour don't matter.
Ess og konge er naboer: et ess kan legge: Ace and king are neighbours: an ace can go on a king, and a king on an ace.
Et kort snus når ingen kort ligger over: A card turns over when no card lies on top of it. Stuck? Tap the pile for a new card. You can only go through the pile once.
Lange rekker gir flyt: velg det kortet s: Long runs keep things flowing: pick the card that opens up the most new ones.
Every deal here can come out.
Rydd alle sju kolonnene. Kortene går til: Clear all seven columns. The cards go to the waste pile one at a time.
Trykk på det nederste kortet i en kolonn: Tap the bottom card of a column if it is one higher or one lower than the card on the waste pile. Suit and colour don't matter.
Ingenting kan legges på en konge, og ess: Nothing can go on a king, and ace and king are not neighbours.
Trykk på bunken for å legge et nytt kort: Tap the pile to put a new card on the waste pile. You can only go through the pile once.
Alle kabalene her kan gå opp – men det k: Every deal here can come out – but it takes planning.
Spades only. Relaxed and good for learning.
Spades and hearts. A bit more to think about.
Lyst på noe annet? Under «Flere kabaler»: Fancy something else? Under ‘More patience games’ you'll find Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, Tri Peaks and Golf – each with its own rules.
Alle kolonnene må ha kort før du deler u: Every column needs cards before you deal.
